description: T04 six-phase bar with active highlight (doc §4). The pills live in the bottom PhaseStrip (between the game log and the right-hand panel; the strip's placement is pinned by T_phase_strip_bottom), so each pill is /root/Main/PhaseStrip/PhaseBar/PhasePill_<PHASE>. The sixth pill is the game's real sixth phase, Score (PhasePill_SCORING): MORALE is a deprecated slot PhaseManager remaps to COMMAND. Fixture audit_baseline_postdeploy (battle round 1, P1 Custodes active), loaded straight into its saved Command phase with no runner transition: the player's load path, where the strip used to stay hidden until the next phase change. (1) Command: six pills exist with their words, untruncated, in a 21 px row inside the 30 px strip and above the 6 px PlayerTurnBorder; Command's modulate is UIConstants.player_slot_color(1) (TEAL 00b3b3ff), the other five have modulate.a == 0.4. (2) A real click on the End Command Phase button, the confirm dialog's End Command Phase, and Decline on Player 2's War Cry offer reach Movement: Command now modulates to Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1) within 0.05 per channel, Movement is TEAL, Shooting onward future. (3) Same clicks for End Movement Phase reach Shooting: Command + Movement grey, Shooting TEAL, Charge onward future. In every phase the pill/strip/neighbour panel rects equal the Command ones (no layout shift), the rendered frame's CIE L* puts the lit pill more than 8 above every other pill and completed pills more than 20 apart from future ones, and the phase_bar diff between phases is above 11% (both changed pills ~14%; a single pill ~7%; the task's floor is 3%). (4) Setup privilege, not the player path: GameState.set_active_player(2) + transition to Command, then Movement: the lit pill turns MAGENTA (e633b3ff), proving it follows the active player's slot, every pill is re-derived on the way back, and MAGENTA (L* 54) still out-lights a completed grey pill (L* 43).

steps.equals: Command > Movement > Shooting > Charge > Fight > Score
